Verse of the Day
Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the Lord will do great things.
Joel 2:21
Quote of the Day
"Because Jesus Christ completed the Atonement, He has the power to help you along your earthly journey and to redeem you from death."
Elder Dale G. Renlund | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
